SELECT stage,
    count(*) AS project_count,
    COALESCE(sum(quoted_sqm), (0)::numeric) AS total_sqm
   FROM projects
  GROUP BY stage
  ORDER BY
        CASE stage
            WHEN 'New Lead'::text THEN 1
            WHEN 'Catalog Sent'::text THEN 2
            WHEN 'Quotation Sent'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'Under Review'::text THEN 4
            WHEN 'Won'::text THEN 5
            WHEN 'In Production'::text THEN 6
            WHEN 'Delivered'::text THEN 7
            WHEN 'Lost'::text THEN 8
            ELSE 9
        END;

SELECT b.id AS branch_id,
    b.name AS branch_name,
    b.region,
    r.id AS rep_id,
    r.name AS rep_name,
    r.monthly_target_sqm,
    COALESCE(sum(a.sqm_done), (0)::numeric) AS sqm_done_month,
    count(a.id) AS activity_count_month
   FROM ((branches b
     LEFT JOIN reps r ON (((r.branch_id = b.id) AND (r.status = 'active'::text) AND (r.role = ANY (ARRAY['rep'::text, 'marketing'::text])))))
     LEFT JOIN activities a ON (((a.rep_id = r.id) AND (a.activity_date >= date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_DATE)::timestamp with time zone)))))
  WHERE (b.is_active = true)
  GROUP BY b.id, b.name, b.region, r.id, r.name, r.monthly_target_sqm
  ORDER BY b.name, r.name;

SELECT r.id AS rep_id,
    r.name AS rep_name,
    r.monthly_target_sqm AS target_sqm,
    (date_trunc('month'::text, (a.activity_date)::timestamp with time zone))::date AS month_start,
    to_char((a.activity_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'Month YYYY'::text) AS month_label,
    COALESCE(sum(a.sqm_done), (0)::numeric) AS achieved_sqm,
    COALESCE(sum(a.sqm_expected), (0)::numeric) AS pipeline_sqm,
    count(a.id) AS activity_count
   FROM (reps r
     LEFT JOIN activities a ON ((a.rep_id = r.id)))
  WHERE (r.status = 'active'::text)
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.monthly_target_sqm, (date_trunc('month'::text, (a.activity_date)::timestamp with time zone)), (to_char((a.activity_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'Month YYYY'::text));

SELECT p.id,
    p.project_code,
    p.project_name,
    p.stage,
    p.customer_id,
    c.company_name,
    p.next_follow_up,
    p.stage_changed_at,
    (now() - p.stage_changed_at) AS time_in_stage,
    r.name AS assigned_rep_name
   FROM ((projects p
     LEFT JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = p.customer_id)))
     LEFT JOIN reps r ON ((r.id = p.assigned_rep_id)))
  WHERE ((p.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['Won'::text, 'Delivered'::text, 'Lost'::text])) AND ((p.stage_changed_at < (now() - '14 days'::interval)) OR (p.stage_changed_at IS NULL)))
  ORDER BY p.stage_changed_at NULLS FIRST;
